if: a company is computing depreciation on an asset under Schedule II
a useful life or a residual value is being adopted
then: the useful life SHALL NOT ordinarily be different from the useful life specified in Part C, and the residual value SHALL NOT be more than five per cent. of the original cost of the asset; and where either differs, the financial statements SHALL disclose such difference and provide justification in this behalf duly supported by technical advice
source_section: Companies Act, 2013, Schedule II, Part A, paragraph 3(i) and its proviso
note: The five per cent. cap is on ORIGINAL COST, not on carrying amount and not on the depreciable amount. Departure is permitted but priced: disclosure plus technical advice. The printed paragraph 3(i) is NOT the 2013 enactment — the Schedule's own footnote records substitution by Notification G.S.R. 627(E) dated 29 August 2014. UNKNOWN — source is the Act as enacted 2013; amendments not held locally.
